text:
maria_ryan: Heads-up — we're seeing a wave of tiny-pod OOMs and preemptions in eu-west1-a starting ~05:30 UTC. Eviction spike coincides with several rack-reserve reallocs.

samir: saw it, looks like reserved padding on rack pools didn't account for fractional GPU memory overcommit. pods stuck Pending -> Bound -> OOM in under 10s :grimacing:

ops-bot: [Alert] 5482390011: 18 evictions in 3m on cluster-eu-west1-a. Top reason: NodeOOM

johnw: any pattern? which node types / instance families?

maria_ryan: mostly gpus with nvlink-enabled racks, 8gpu nodes. the scheduler's padding calc uses a flat slot count, not PCIe bandwidth or GPU mem frag. when rack-reserve moves a "stripe" it leaves unusable 1-2 GPU slices per node.

katie: ah — so fragmentation in slot allocation causes tiny pods to be scheduled on nodes with insufficient contiguous GPU memory -> OOM when init cache loads.

samir: I reproduced locally: k8s scheduler's binpack plugin plus our rack-reserve controller reserves N GPUs per-rack by writing a fake DaemonSet pod annotation. That fake reservation doesn't mark per-GPU memory, only counts slots. So a node can have count>=requested but contiguous memory < requested.

maria_ryan: log snippet:
```
[kubelet] admitPod: pod=training-worker-xyz, requested.gpu=1, node.available.gpu_slices=1, available.contig_gpu_mem=0.6GiB, required=1.0GiB
[kubelet] OOMKill: process=loader, msg=failed to allocate KV cache
```

johnw: proposals?

katie: two immediate fixes:
1) reduce rack-reserve padding from 10% -> 3% for eu-west1 canary
2) change reservation artifact to annotate per-GPU memory reservation (new annotation: `gpu.redwood/contig_mem_reserve`)

samir: longer-term: scheduler change to prefer contiguous-slice placement (new predicate) and add pci-e awareness for NVLINK clusters.

maria_ryan: canary plan: roll padding change to eu-west1-a only, monitor evictions metric + OOMs for 30m. If stable, roll to other racks.

katie: I'll open a quick PR for the rack-reserve controller, test locally. pinging @johnw for canary approval.

johnw: approve canary. Also add a temporary autoscaler cap so we don't overshoot when padding lowers.

ops-bot: [Action] Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/eviction-wave — recommended: set `rack-reserve.padding` and `autoscaler.max-burst`.

maria_ryan: thanks. I'll push patch now and post progress updates here :thumbsup:

samir: FYI I observed NIC egress saturation on two racks — if padding reduction causes burst, we might see net kink. will add NIC throttle to canary bucket.

katie: noted, adding NIC metrics to dashboard.

maria_ryan: 5482390200: patched rack-reserve padding -> 3% in eu-west1-a canary

ops-bot: [Alert] 5482390305: evictions down to 3/min from 40/min previous 10m

maria_ryan: good signal. continuing 30m watch.

johnw: if steady at 5/min or less after 30m, roll to eu-west1-b.

maria_ryan: will update in ~20m.
